upstreamFrontmatter.name: graphify
upstreamFrontmatter.description: Use for any question about a codebase, its architecture, file relationships, or project content — especially when graphify-out/ exists, where the question should be treated as a graphify query first. Turns any input (code, docs, papers, images, videos) into a persistent knowledge graph with god nodes, community detection, and query/path/explain tools.

adaptations: Renamed skill-agents.md to SKILL.md and included its agents/references directory.
Restricted to user-selected local/browser/Obsidian execution; cloud, remote-provider and foreign-runtime branches disabled.
Russian discovery metadata and task-scoped invocation policy; original descriptions retained in upstreamFrontmatter.
Added local Obsidian explicit-link bridge and persistent multi-project Graphify workflow; runtime engine graphifyy 0.9.92 is installed separately from PyPI.
